units.en: The ⟦0⟧ is a releasable country that can be created via the decision "Incorporate the West Britain Company" if the ⟦1⟧ controls and occupies Wales.

The Mughal West Britain Company is a hypothetical nation encompassing the Welsh state. And the Mughal Empire has reformed, having been freed from the British shackles, and has taken the fight against the Allies, notably against the United Kingdom, extracting revenge for the 1857 decline.
Main article: Generic national focus tree
⟦0⟧, lacking a unique national focus tree, uses the generic national focus tree instead.
The generic focus tree has 5 main branches:
Gives army experience and research bonuses to army research.
Gives air experience, builds air bases, and research bonuses to air research.
Gives navy experience, builds naval dockyards, and research bonuses to navy research.
Builds civilian and military factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants extra research slots.
Gives the country choices on which political path they will take.

The Mughal West Britain Company starts the game with 2 Research slots though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
⟦0⟧ controls and cores ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ if it is decision released by the ⟦3⟧.
When released, the Mughal West Britain Company will start as a Non Aligned nation that does not have elections upon release.
The Mughal West Britain Company is technically a civil war tag of the ⟦0⟧, it has the same political parties:
note: The name changes on the non aligned parties depend on the current leadership that the Mughal Empire has.
The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.
Overview of Mughal West Britain Company

Mughal West Britain Company doesn't possess a tag of its own. Instead it comes with a civil war tag, and dependent by British Raj national focus. Although by console commands, all you have to do is to occupy Wales core with console commands. And with console commands again take the "Incorporate the West Britain Company" decision that allegedly releases them as a puppet state. Mughal West Britain Company starts with 2,3M core population but, a puppet state of British Raj. And with one civilian factory, three aluminium and 11 steel.

Now, the first thing you should do is take the first Political focus, which will give you 120 political power, plus the 70 you have already accumulated. Use this to get a communist advisor. Yes, I know, going communist is the go-to strategy for basically every minor, but if it works, it works. While you wait for communist support to tick up, take some industrial focuses to get some free factories. Grab the two free civilian factories first, then get the three military factories. By this time you should be above fifty percent communist support, so hold a referendum to become Communist Mughal West Britain Company. Use your excess political power to get war economy, and if you have any extra left, get some Improved Worker Conditions or Anti-Communist/Democratic raids.Build cheap submarines, only a few suffice to make amends onto naval invasion, after going with the Naval Effort focus. Then, with decent political power hire a chief of army for an early army experience boost. After that, go for the political effort. Go communist, and ignite a civil war.

By now you should have a total of 8 or 9 factories- 6 civilian and 3 military. One of your civilian factories will be used for consumer goods, so use the remaining one to either build some more civs or trade for some steel. Use one of your 3 military factories to produce artillery, and use the other 2 to build guns. Set some factories to build support equipment as well once you get some more mils.

At this point, you've flipped communist already, so start justifying on Ireland. With the same logic and console commands if you have released yourself from British Raj's clutches. At the same time start working on the political focuses. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out, and start with the naval invasions and capture its capital. At the same time, justify on Republican Spain, if they are currently losing in the Spanish Civil War. Manpower can be an issue so take the "Ideological Loyalty" as the Welsh manpower will go absent way quick. Should you declare on Portugal, Iceland, or god forbid, the United Kingdom and win against them each other can give you enough expansion and access to some valuable resources and sea access for marine trade.

Tip: If you let independent Mughal West Britain Company be controlled by an AI, it will annex British Raj by referendum if they share the same ideology. Mughal West Britain Company that way will gain additional cores and as well as a bigger army, and inheriting claims from British Raj itself.
